parts.tpd_3V3_pm0V3: 1 min / 3.6 max ns (-40..85C); 1 / 4.1 ns (-40..125C) (Sec 6.6); test load CL=50 pF, 500 Ohm to 6 V (Sec 7.3)

parts.VIN_range: 1 V to 5.5 V (Features; ROC VIN 0-5.5 V, Sec 6.3)
parts.IMAX: 2 A continuous at TA=70C; 2.5 A pulsed <300 us 2% duty (Sec 6.1)
parts.ON_VIH_VIL: VIH 1-5.5 V, VIL 0-0.5 V for VIN 1-5.5 V (Sec 6.3); hysteresis 107 mV typ (Sec 6.5); active high, do not float (Sec 8.3.1)
parts.IQ_ISD_at_3V3: IQ 8.3 typ / 15 max uA; ISD 0.5 typ / 3.5 max uA (Sec 6.5)

QOD.configs: QOD tied to VOUT (RPD), via REXT (RQOD=RPD+REXT, Eq 1), or floating = no discharge (Sec 8.3.2, Table 4)
QOD.limit: with internal RPD only, total CL must not exceed 200 uF (Sec 8.3.2.2)

CT_rise_time.formula: SR [us/V] = 0.55 x CT[pF] + 30 ; rise time ~ VIN x SR (10-90%), not valid for CT=0 (Sec 8.3.3, Eq 3)

parts.switching_3V3_CT1nF: tON 1430 us, tR 1680 us, tD 590 us, tOFF 2 us typ (Sec 6.6)
parts.reverse_current_blocking: NO. Single N-FET with body diode; if VOUT > VIN current flows VOUT->VIN through body diode; CIN:CL 10:1 recommended (Sec 9.2.2.2). No reverse-blocking feature described.

VIT_min_max_derived_-40..125C.note: derived = nominal x (1 +/- accuracy); datasheet gives % not absolute V

parts.hysteresis: fixed 1% typ/2.5% max of VIT; G01 1.5%/3%
parts.MR: active low, internal 90 kOhm pull-up to VDD (70 min); VIL 0.3VDD, VIH 0.7VDD (Sec 6.5, 7.3.3); can be left open
parts.RESET_output: open-drain, active low; pull-up 10k-1M, may pull up to <=6.5 V above VDD (Table 5-1, Sec 7.3.4); VOL 0.4 V max @1 mA (VDD>=1.8V); leakage 300 nA max

parts.note: push-pull active-low RESET, no CT pin, fixed ~200 ms delay; DBZ SOT23-3 / DQN X2SON-4

parts.power_good: Only P variants: TLV62569PDDC (SOT23-6) and TLV62569PDRL (SOT563); DBV (SOT23-5) has NO PG. PG open-drain, high-Z above 95% VFB, low below 90%; sink 1 mA; pull-up <=5.5 V (Sec 7.4.2, Table 1, device comparison)
parts.IOUT: 0-2 A (Sec 6.3); HS current limit 3 A typ DBV/PDDC (Sec 6.5)
parts.VFB: 0.588 / 0.6 / 0.612 V (min/typ/max) at VIN=5V, TJ=25C only (Sec 6.5) = +/-2% at 25C; over-temperature limit NOT_FOUND
parts.VOUT_equation: VOUT = 0.6 V x (1 + R1/R2), R2 <= 200 kOhm (R1 top, R2 bottom) (Sec 8.2.2.2 Eq 2); example 1.8 V: R1=200k, R2=100k, optional feed-forward C3 6.8 pF
parts.L_C_recommended: 2.2 uH + 10 uF COUT standard (Table 4 '++'); COUT 10-47 uF; CIN 4.7 uF (Sec 8.2.2.5); example L1 XAL4020-222ME, C2 10uF X7R 0805 (Table 3)
parts.EN_thresholds: VIH 0.95 typ / 1.2 max V; VIL 0.4 min / 0.85 typ V (2.5<=VIN<=5.5) (Sec 6.5); do not float

parts.EN: VHI 1 V min, VLO 0.3 V max (Sec 5.5)
parts.output_discharge: P = active discharge, RPULLDOWN 120 Ohm (Sec 5.5, Table 8-1)
parts.reverse_current: no reverse-current protection; body diode, VOUT > VIN+0.3 V exceeds abs max (Sec 7.1.4)
parts.orderables: TLV75518PDBVR and TLV75533PDBVR listed Active (Package Option Addendum)

parts.C_IO_GND: 0.7 pF typ (DRT), VIO=2.5V f=100kHz; C_IO-IO 0.05 pF (Sec 6.5)

pinout_DQA.ref: Table 4-2 (NC used for flow-through routing; float or ground)

parts.line_capacitance: 0.5 pF typ (DQA), VIO=2.5V f=1MHz, I/O to GND (Sec 5.4)

parts.ratings: VBUS 5 A collectively, GND 6.25 A, A5/B5 1.25 A, others 0.25 A/pin; 48 V DC; 20,000 cycles; -40..85 C
parts.CC_sink_requirement: Rd pulldown on CC1 and CC2 required for sink. Value reference found only indirectly: TI TUSB320LAI integrated RCC_D = 4.6/5.1/5.6 kOhm and legacy-adapter figure 'Rd (5.1k +/- 10%)' (S18 Sec 6.5, Sec 7.1.1.3). parts.SOIC-8_208mil: NOT offered (no 'S' package code for W25Q256JV in either revision)
parts.dedicated_RESET_pin: Only SOIC-16 (F) and TFBGA (B/C) (Features note 1, Sec 4.6). WSON/WFLGA pin 7 is '/HOLD or /RESET (IO3)'.

pinout_SOIC16_300mil_F.note: /RESET (pin 3) may be left floating or tied to VCC if unused (note 3)

parts.QE_default: IQ/JQ: QE=1 factory fixed (Quad IO2/IO3 enabled, /HOLD disabled); IM/JM: QE=0 factory default (/HOLD enabled) (Sec 7.1.4 Quad Enable under Status Register-2 (datasheet reuses 7.1.x numbering), Sec 9.8)
parts.address_mode: ADP (SR3 S17, non-volatile) factory default 0 -> powers up in 3-byte mode; ADS (S16) shows current mode; Extended Address Register needed above 128 Mb in 3-byte mode (Sec 6.1.4, 7.1.6)
parts.extended_address_register: Volatile; EA0 = A24 selects upper/lower 128 Mb; write C5h, read C8h; cleared to 0 on power-up/reset; ignored in 4-byte mode but 4-byte-address commands overwrite it (Sec 7.2, Table 1)

power_up_Sec_9.3.note: /CS must track VCC at power-up/down; pull-up on /CS suggested (Sec 6.2)

parts.reset: Software: 66h then 99h, tRST 30 us (Sec 6.1.5, 9.7). Hardware /RESET low >= 1 us recommended (tRESET; may work at a few hundred ns) (Sec 9.7 note 4)

status_register_protection.SR1: S7 SRP, S6 TB, S5-S2 BP3-BP0, S1 WEL, S0 BUSY
status_register_protection.SR2: S15 SUS, S14 CMP, S13-S11 LB3-LB1, S9 QE, S8 SRL
status_register_protection.SR3: S22-S21 DRV1/DRV0 (default 25%), S18 WPS, S17 ADP, S16 ADS
status_register_protection.defaults: BP=0 (none protected), TB=0, CMP=0, SRP/SRL=0 (software protection), WPS=0 (BP scheme). When WPS=1 all Individual Block Lock bits power up = 1 (locked)

parts.timing: tPP 0.4/3 ms, tSE 50/400 ms, tBE2 150/2000 ms, tCE 80/400 s (typ/max, Sec 9.7)

pinout_TQFN16.EP: not internally connected; connect to GND plane for thermal

parts.SD_MODE_function_Table_5: V>B2: Left; B1<V<B2 (pull-up via RSMALL): Right; B0<V<B1 (via RLARGE): (L+R)/2; V<B0: shutdown

SD_MODE_resistors.equations: RSMALL(kOhm) = 94.0 x VDDIO - 100 ; RLARGE(kOhm) = 222.2 x VDDIO - 100
SD_MODE_resistors.VDDIO=3.3V (Table 6): Left: drive directly high; Right: RSMALL 210.2 kOhm; (L+R)/2: RLARGE 634 kOhm; Shutdown: drive low
SD_MODE_resistors.caution: left mode direct drive must not exceed abs max (VDD+0.3V); if VDD<3.0V with 3.3V logic add ~2 kOhm series (SD_MODE section)

I2S_interface.BCLK_range: 0.2432-25.804 MHz; BCLK must be 32, 48 or 64 x LRCLK
I2S_interface.polarity: data on BCLK rising edge; LRCLK low = left (MAX98357A)
I2S_interface.caution: do not remove LRCLK while BCLK present; BCLK removal -> standby

parts.quiescent_current: 2.75 typ / 3.35 max mA (VDD=5V, 25C); 2.4/2.85 mA at 3.7 V; shutdown 0.6/2 uA; standby (no BCLK) 340/400 uA
parts.other: fsw 330 kHz filterless; current limit 2.8 A; bypass 0.1 uF + 10 uF on VDD; temp -40..85 C

parts.OE_polarity: Per-channel, active LOW: OE=L -> Y=A; OE=H -> Hi-Z (Table 7-1). Datasheet recommends OE pull-up to VCC for Hi-Z during power-up/down (Sec 3).
parts.vcc: 1.65-3.6 V (NOT 5 V capable supply); inputs tolerate 5.5 V
parts.Ioff: NOT_FOUND - no Ioff parameter or partial-power-down feature in this datasheet (unlike LVC1G125/LVC07A). Do not rely on back-drive protection.

parts.VDD: 2.7-5 V (Sec 6.3); VDD >= 3.5 V needed to advertise 3 A
parts.mode_select_ADDR: Tri-level: NC = GPIO mode (I2C disabled); H = I2C addr 0x67; L = I2C addr 0x47 (Pin Functions, Sec 7.2.4)
parts.port_role_PORT: Tri-level: H = DFP (source), NC = DRP, L = UFP (sink) - tie to GND for sink (Pin Functions, Sec 7.2.1.2)

GPIO_current_report_Table_3.note: OUT1/OUT2 open-drain, valid in UFP mode; OUT3 low = audio accessory

parts.UFP_sink_config: PORT=L, VBUS via 900 kOhm (887k typ, 855-920k) to VBUS_DET; integrated Rd RCC_D 4.6/5.1/5.6 kOhm, dead-battery Rd 4.1/5.1/6.1 kOhm (Sec 6.5, 7.2.5)
parts.cautions: EN_N held low >=50 ms after VDD valid if driven; VDD ramp <=25 ms; when I2C pulled to 3.3 V, VDD must be >=3.0 V or back-powering occurs; I2C VDD_I2C 1.65-3.6 V (Pin Functions notes, Sec 6.5)
